prompt_version_note: v5: step-by-step uses the same answer labels as all-in-one (Transliteration: / Gloss:); with v4's 'Step 1 - Transliteration:' / 'Step 2 - Gloss:' labels Bolmo returned empty answers on 10/10 Ainu eval rows. All prompts are language-neutral templates ({language} is filled from the language config). For Korean the all-in-one and two-stage prompts are identical to v3.
prompt_source: Korean IGT Experimental Protocol V3, section 2 (agenda 17 Nov); step-by-step = one call that asks for step 1 then step 2 (tutor, 20 Nov)

generation.stop_rule: single-answer prompts: first complete line; all-in-one and step-by-step: transliteration line + gloss line

few_shot.note: Used only with --shots K > 0. K fixed train examples (same for every evaluated row), drawn with this seed from train rows that have all fields, a gloss tag, at least min_text_words words, text <= max_text_chars and gloss <= max_gloss_chars, and whose text is not in the dev or test split (so the examples are the same for both).
